steps.en: Install the framework and its dev tools
Subclass App, yield widgets from compose() and style them with CSS
steps.zh: 继承 App，在 compose() 里产出控件，用 CSS 定样式

steps.en: Lays the widgets out by your CSS rules and draws them in the terminal
steps.zh: 按你的 CSS 规则排版控件，画到终端里

steps.en: Write on_… handlers that react to events and update widgets
steps.zh: 写 on_… 处理函数，响应事件、更新控件

steps.en: Turns keys, mouse clicks and resizes into messages, calls your handlers and redraws
steps.zh: 把按键、鼠标点击和窗口缩放变成消息，调用你的处理函数并重绘

value.en: A keyboard-and-mouse app that runs anywhere Python and a terminal do, including over SSH — and in a browser via textual serve
value.zh: 键盘鼠标都能用的应用，有 Python 和终端就能跑，SSH 上也行，还能用 textual serve 进浏览器

sources: https://github.com/Textualize/textual#textual (ClockApp example: App subclass, CSS, compose() -> ComposeResult, on_ready, query_one().update)
https://textual.textualize.io/guide/events/ (events and messages dispatched to on_ handlers)
